title: ULTA/SEPHORA $75 GIFT CARD GIVEAWAY!!(CLOSED)
description: Hello my A-Baes!!  Here is the long awaited giveaway!! I will be giving away a $75 gift card to either Ulta or Sephora, it will be the winner's choice. All you have to do is be subscribed, and comment below and question you may have for me! This contest will go for about a month, on December 1st I will be closing it and pick a winner, which will be when I answer all of your questions!   So be sure to enter, share with all your friends and family, and good luck!!  Thank you so much again for 2500 subscribers, lets get to 3,000!!  Thanks for watching my loves!!  xoxo, Andrea  Add me on Snapchat! @andream133
